paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy scores for Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on the MATH-500 benchmark, divided into five bins along the horizontal axis labeled "Pass@1", which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The vertical axis, labeled "Percentage", is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Each bar represents the percentage of samples falling within a specific Pass@1 bin, with the bin boundaries aligned to the tick marks on the x-axis. The first bar (0.0–0.2) reaches approximately 0.11 (labeled 11.2%), the second (0.2–0.4) is around 0.034 (labeled 3.4%), the third (0.4–0.6) is also 0.034 (labeled 3.4%), the fourth (0.6–0.8) is approximately 0.058 (labeled 5.8%), and the fifth (0.8–1.0) is the tallest, reaching approximately 0.76 (labeled 76.2%). A red dashed vertical line is drawn at approximately 0.82 on the x-axis, labeled "mean: 0.82", indicating the mean Pass@1 score across all samples. All bars are light blue with black outlines, and the percentages are labeled directly above each bar. The distribution is heavily skewed toward the highest bin, with the majority of samples achieving Pass@1 scores above 0.8.
